answer: To join, a name must pass Faithful silk weaver guild patent, which works because a patent weavers file after shuttle hearings. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Before the stamp comes 50 stamped dockets, each costing £7 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One signal, one entry. The clerk notes delta. The cipher is checked, not assumed.
